title: Defects Of Vision
definition: A comprehensive study of human eye optics abnormalities including myopia, hypermetropia, presbyopia, astigmatism, and cataract, caused by structural elongation, flattening, or aging of the crystalline lens and cornea.
importanceInUpsc: Frequently tested in UPSC Prelims (General Science - Physics/Biology interface) via direct application questions on corrective lenses, focal lengths, and refractive errors, and relevant to public health schemes in Mains GS-2.
learningOutcomes: Master foundational concepts and optical correction mechanisms of Defects Of Vision.
Evaluate spatial distribution of blindness, national health policies, and institutional frameworks.
Apply high-yield mnemonics to solve tricky Prelims and Mains questions regarding lens types.
